assessment_recalculation_processed_field.name: assessment_recalculation_processed_fields_check
assessment_recalculation_processed_field.value:
(
        ("assessment_recalculation_candidates"."status" = 'PENDING' and "assessment_recalculation_candidates"."recalculated_version" is null and "assessment_recalculation_candidates"."recalculated_score" is null and "assessment_recalculation_candidates"."recalculated_outcome" is null and "assessment_recalculation_candidates"."recalculated_at" is null and "assessment_recalculation_candidates"."notification_queued_at" is null)
        or
        ("assessment_recalculation_candidates"."status" in ('CALCULATED', 'NOTIFICATION_QUEUED') and "assessment_recalculation_candidates"."recalculated_version" is not null and "assessment_recalculation_candidates"."recalculated_score" is not null and "assessment_recalculation_candidates"."recalculated_outcome" is not null and "assessment_recalculation_candidates"."recalculated_at" is not null)
      )

appeals_decision_check.name: appeals_decision_check
appeals_decision_check.value: (("appeals"."status" in ('DECIDIDA', 'RECALCULO_PENDENTE', 'ENCERRADA') and "appeals"."decision" is not null and "appeals"."decision" in ('MANTER_RESULTADO', 'ANULAR_ITEM', 'ALTERAR_RESULTADO')) or ("appeals"."status" in ('ABERTA', 'EM_REVISAO') and "appeals"."decision" is null))

appeals_justification_check.name: appeals_justification_check
appeals_justification_check.value: length(trim("appeals"."justification")) between 1 and 10000 and "appeals"."justification" not like '%<%>'

feedback_tickets_response_check.name: feedback_tickets_response_check
feedback_tickets_response_check.value: (("feedback_tickets"."response" is null and "feedback_tickets"."response_at" is null and "feedback_tickets"."response_by" is null) or ("feedback_tickets"."response" is not null and "feedback_tickets"."response_at" is not null))

feedback_tickets_technical_context_check.name: feedback_tickets_technical_context_check
feedback_tickets_technical_context_check.value:
(
        ("feedback_tickets"."logical_page" is null and "feedback_tickets"."app_version" is null and "feedback_tickets"."occurred_at" is null and "feedback_tickets"."error_code" is null)
        or (
          "feedback_tickets"."logical_page" is not null
          and "feedback_tickets"."app_version" is not null
          and "feedback_tickets"."logical_page" ~ '^/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9/_:-]{0,127}$'
          and "feedback_tickets"."app_version" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]{0,63}$'
          and ("feedback_tickets"."error_code" is null or "feedback_tickets"."error_code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$')
        )
      )

learning_assignments_block_reason_check.name: learning_assignments_block_reason_check
learning_assignments_block_reason_check.value: (("learning_assignments"."status" = 'BLOQUEADO' and "learning_assignments"."block_reason" is not null and "learning_assignments"."block_reason" in ('PRE_REQUISITO', 'CONTEUDO_RETIRADO', 'OBJETIVO_EM_REMEDIACAO')) or ("learning_assignments"."status" <> 'BLOQUEADO' and "learning_assignments"."block_reason" is null))

learning_assignments_paused_from_check.name: learning_assignments_paused_from_check
learning_assignments_paused_from_check.value: (("learning_assignments"."status" = 'PAUSADO' and "learning_assignments"."paused_from" is not null and "learning_assignments"."paused_from" in ('NAO_ATRIBUIDO', 'ATRIBUIDO', 'DISPONIVEL', 'EM_ANDAMENTO', 'CONCLUIDO', 'EM_REFORCO', 'CONCLUIDO_COM_RETENCAO_PENDENTE', 'BLOQUEADO')) or ("learning_assignments"."status" <> 'PAUSADO' and "learning_assignments"."paused_from" is null))

learning_assignments_pause_context_check.name: learning_assignments_pause_context_check
learning_assignments_pause_context_check.value: (("learning_assignments"."status" = 'PAUSADO' and "learning_assignments"."pause_reason" is not null and "learning_assignments"."pause_reason" in ('AFASTAMENTO', 'ACOMODACAO', 'JANELA_OPERACIONAL')) or ("learning_assignments"."status" <> 'PAUSADO' and "learning_assignments"."pause_reason" is null and "learning_assignments"."resume_at" is null))
